customer: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the wider MENA region who work with several clients at once
problem: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt struggle to track client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.
solution: A digital template pack (Notion and Google Sheets) that helps freelance graphic designers in Egypt track client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.
value_proposition: Bilingual Arabic and English, built for local freelancing habits, with no subscriptions that lock users in and no collection of client data.

hypotheses.text: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region will pay USD 100 for a digital template pack that helps them track client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.
hypotheses.test: Create a landing page with a call-to-action to purchase the template pack and track the number of sign-ups or pre-orders within a week.

hypotheses.text: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region will use the template pack to track client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.
hypotheses.test: Offer a free version of the template pack to a small group of designers and ask them to provide feedback on its usefulness within a week.

hypotheses.text: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region will prefer a bilingual (Arabic and English) template pack over a single-language one.
hypotheses.test: Create two versions of the template pack—one in Arabic and one in English—and ask a sample of designers to rate their preference for each version.

hypotheses.text: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region will not collect client data through the template pack.
hypotheses.test: Include a privacy policy in the template pack and ask a sample of designers to confirm they understand and agree with the privacy policy.
